user.title: Bitpanda
user.description:
Which service do you want to set up? Each one can be added once.

- **Bitpanda Portfolio**: your account – everything you hold at Bitpanda.
- **Bitpanda Price Tracker**: live prices of the assets you choose – whether you hold them or not.

menu_options.price_tracker: Bitpanda Price Tracker (no API key required)

portfolio.title: Bitpanda Portfolio
portfolio.description:
The Bitpanda Portfolio shows your Bitpanda account in Home Assistant: its total value, your returns, and a wallet for every asset you hold. The integration creates the wallets itself and removes them when you no longer hold an asset – you do not need to add or delete any.

For this, the integration needs an API key. To create one:

1. Open [{api_key_url}]({api_key_url}) and create a new key.
2. Select only the permissions Guthaben (Balance), Transaktion (Transaction) and Earn (Read) – not Trading.
3. Copy the key and paste it below. Bitpanda shows it only once.

The integration only reads with it: it cannot trade or move money.
Bitpanda keys are valid for one year; after that, Home Assistant asks for a new one.
You can replace the key at any time: open the ⋮ menu of the "Bitpanda Portfolio" entry on the Bitpanda integration page and choose "Reconfigure".

currency.title: Bitpanda Portfolio
currency.description: The API key works. Now choose your portfolio's currency and the language of group titles and messages.

data_description.currency: Bitpanda reports every value of your portfolio in this currency. To change it later, open the ⋮ menu of the "Bitpanda Portfolio" entry on the Bitpanda integration page and choose "Reconfigure". Changing it deletes all Portfolio sensors including their history and creates them again in the new currency.

data.language: Language of group titles and messages

data_description.language: Group titles, such as "Cryptocurrencies", appear in this language, and so does the message explaining why a device cannot be deleted. Sensor names follow Home Assistant's system language, dialogs and attribute names the language of your user profile. You can change this language later with "Configure" (⚙) on the "Bitpanda Portfolio" entry of the Bitpanda integration page.

price_tracker.title: Bitpanda Price Tracker
price_tracker.description:
The Bitpanda Price Tracker always creates a price sensor in EUR for every tracked asset. Optionally, select additional currencies here to also show the prices in them.

You can also choose or change the additional currencies and the language later with "Configure" (⚙) on the "Bitpanda Price Tracker" entry of the Bitpanda integration page. Add assets after the setup with "Add price tracker" on the same entry.

data_description.extra_currencies: Each selected currency adds one more sensor per asset, converted with the daily reference rates of the European Central Bank.

data_description.language: Group titles, such as "Cryptocurrencies", appear in this language. Sensor names follow Home Assistant's system language, dialogs and attribute names the language of your user profile.

reauth_confirm.title: New Bitpanda API key needed
reauth_confirm.description:
Bitpanda rejected the stored API key. It may have expired, or it predates the permissions this version needs.
Create a new key at [{api_key_url}]({api_key_url}) and paste it here. Your sensors are kept.

data_description.api_key: The new key needs the permissions Guthaben (Balance), Transaktion (Transaction) and Earn (Read) – not Trading.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Bitpanda Portfolio
reconfigure.description: Replace the stored API key, change the currency, or both.

data_description.api_key:
Leave empty to keep the current key.
A new key from [{api_key_url}]({api_key_url}) needs the permissions Guthaben (Balance), Transaktion (Transaction) and Earn (Read) – not Trading.
data_description.currency: Changing the currency deletes all Portfolio sensors including their history; you confirm this in the next step.

confirm_currency.title: Change the currency?
confirm_currency.description:
Changing the currency from {old} to {new} deletes all Portfolio sensors including their history and recreates them in the new currency. The deleted history cannot be restored; the currency itself can be changed again at any time.

Select "Submit" to change the currency. To keep {old}, close this dialog with the "X" instead: nothing changes then, and a new API key you entered is not saved either.

data_description.extra_currencies:
Each selected currency adds one more sensor per asset, converted with the daily reference rates of the European Central Bank.
Removing a currency removes those sensors; their history is kept and comes back when you select the currency again.

renamed_entities.title: Bitpanda upgrade: entity IDs renamed
renamed_entities.description:
The upgrade to the two services Bitpanda Portfolio and Bitpanda Price Tracker renamed these entity IDs; their history moved with them. Check dashboards, automations and scripts that still use the old IDs:

{entities}

entities_not_migrated.title: Bitpanda upgrade: entities not migrated
entities_not_migrated.description:
The upgrade left these entities unchanged, and they are no longer updated. Delete them once you no longer need them. Fiat wallets may be among them: Portfolio Cash now covers every fiat balance. The Home Assistant log names the reason for each entity.

{entities}

currency_dropped.title: Bitpanda upgrade: Portfolio currency changed to EUR
currency_dropped.description: {currency}, the currency of your Bitpanda entry before the upgrade, is not available for the Bitpanda Portfolio, so it now reports every value in EUR. To choose another currency, open the ⋮ menu of the "Bitpanda Portfolio" entry on the Bitpanda integration page and choose "Reconfigure".

price_tracker_exists.title: Bitpanda upgrade: prices to add to the Price Tracker
price_tracker_exists.description:
A Bitpanda Price Tracker was already set up when the upgrade ran, so the prices your old Bitpanda entry tracked were not moved into it. To keep tracking them, add these assets with "Add price tracker" on the "Bitpanda Price Tracker" entry of the Bitpanda integration page:

{assets}

home_assistant_too_old.title: Bitpanda upgrade needs Home Assistant {minimum}
home_assistant_too_old.description: The Bitpanda entry from before the upgrade can only be upgraded on Home Assistant {minimum} or newer, which keeps the history of the renamed sensors. This installation runs Home Assistant {version}, so nothing has been changed. Update Home Assistant; the entry is upgraded at the next start.

portfolio_exists.title: Bitpanda upgrade blocked: a Bitpanda Portfolio is already set up
portfolio_exists.description: The Bitpanda entry "{entry}" from before the upgrade cannot be upgraded: it would become a second Bitpanda Portfolio beside "{portfolio}", and only one can be set up. It has been left unchanged. Delete one of the two entries on the Bitpanda integration page (⋮ → "Delete"). If you keep "{entry}", restart Home Assistant afterwards to upgrade it.

slow_price_interval.title: Bitpanda Price Tracker: prices refresh only every {minutes} minutes
slow_price_interval.description: The Bitpanda Price Tracker tracks {count} assets and needs one request per asset for every refresh. To stay within its request budget, it refreshes their prices only every {minutes} minutes. Track fewer assets for faster updates: delete an asset's device (⋮ on its device page), or a whole group (⋮ on the Bitpanda integration page).

refresh.name: Refresh
refresh.description: Fetches the portfolio and the prices from Bitpanda now and waits until both are done. Ignored within the cooldown of the last call; fails when a refresh fails.
